title: Golliwog
html_source:
Golliwog was a book character, doll, children’s toy, and racist caricature (jet black skin, large red lips, wooly hair, traditional minstrel attire) that became extremely popular around 1900.

The character was first appeared in a children’s book by Florence Kay Upton called “The Adventures of Two Dutch Dolls and a Golliwogg” (1895; see image below for book cover). It and its many sequels were very successful in England, and golliwog dolls became popular toys for young children, similar to teddy bears.
